messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Does metformin work for weight loss?
:
Yes.
Metformin can lead to a modest weight loss.
Results vary.
The weight loss from Metformin is generally smaller than what is seen with medications specifically approved for weight loss.
In the landmark Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP), participants taking metformin lost more weight than those on placebo.
The DPP was a randomized controlled trial in people at high risk for diabetes.
Metformin patients lost 2.7% of body weight after one year.
This was compared to 0.43% for placebo.
Metformin patients also lost 2.1% of body weight after two years.
This was compared to essentially no change (0.02%) for placebo.
29% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year.
Just 13% of people on placebo lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year.
This gap held up at the two-year mark.
At the two-year mark, 26% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight.
At the two-year mark, 14% of people on placebo lost at least 5% of their starting body weight.
Triplet: ["Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP)", "has population", "people at high risk for diabetes"]

The relation 'has population' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject study or trial is conducted on the population or group of individuals specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
C. 'has clinical trial result': The subject drug has demonstrated or shown the clinical trial outcome specified by the object entity.
D. 'used during': The subject drug is administered or utilized during the specific phase or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has higher levels in': The subject drug accumulates to higher levels in the population or group specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
